name: Cossack Squat
steps: Stand with your feet much wider than shoulder width and turn your toes slightly outward.
Shift your weight over one foot and sit your hips deep into a squat over that heel.
Keep your opposite leg straight, letting those toes pivot upward if needed for depth.
Drive through the bent leg to rise back to center and alternate sides.
tips: Keep the heel of the squatting leg planted flat on the floor.
Keep your chest lifted and descend only as deeply as your hip mobility allows with control.
